title: C260 hinge qualification coverage audit
intent: Determine exactly which H01-H28 obligations are supported by the existing four-interface evidence and identify the first remaining gap

requirements.acceptance: Bind unchanged C260 CONTRACT, CONTROL-PLAN and INPUTS, the C253 corpus, and the C261/C265/C266/C267/C268 implementations, independent controls and relevant saved execution evidence to exact revisions, byte sizes and hashes. Separate historical execution from new audit checks.

Record all 28 groups and every material subcase. Cite actual independent assertions, input construction, identities and outcomes. Classify complete, partial, absent or contradictory evidence conservatively. Do not promote a method count or label to group qualification.

requirements.description: Qualification decision and first remaining gap
requirements.acceptance: Publish a human-readable audit and machine-readable map. State whether existing evidence supports contract-wide qualification. Identify one specific next bounded control or investigation, with inputs, acceptance and exclusions. No implementation or contract amendment in this phase.

Pass fresh documentation and workflow checks; verify every local evidence reference and hash binding. Obtain actual independent review of the exact audit candidate, resolve mandatory findings, and retain failures and unrun checks.

Acquire a verified expected-head integration lease, publish one scope branch/PR, merge the reviewed candidate without force, read actual main and run applicable fresh checks. Retain the branch history and observe final branch disposition.

Confirm early recovery before audit work. Verify the final ZIP inventory, manifest, fresh extraction and exact Git snapshots; save the ZIP and both prompts in the existing OntoKin folder. Publish a separate receipt, close task and issue only when all gates pass, release ownership and stop.

plan.title: Scope, reconciliation and early recovery
verification: Live reconciliation, exact startup read-set and confirmed early save

plan.title: Independent coverage investigations
verification: Actual assertion and source/evidence identity inspection for every H group

plan.title: Synthesis, checks and independent review
verification: Fresh documentation/workflow checks and exact-candidate independent review

plan.title: Integration and actual-main checks

plan.title: Saved handoff, receipt and closure
verification: Safe ZIP, manifest/extraction/source verification, confirmed saves and external receipt

next_action: Independently review the exact combined C269 audit candidate and pass fresh documentation/workflow/reference checks; then integrate and save the handoff without implementing missing controls.

session_phase.scope: One evidence-only coverage audit, review, integration and saved handoff
session_phase.acceptance: R01-R06; no group qualification unsupported by exact independent evidence
session_phase.stopping_point: Verified saved handoff and closure, or honest partial at the first unplanned scope expansion; no next implementation phase
